_comment: Editorial content for ARPAK. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available.
description: Arpak International Investments Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 26 July 1977 as a public company and its shares are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It is an investment company whose stated aim is to obtain a high rate of return through diversified and secured investments in national and international markets. It is part of the Premier Group of Companies.
headOffice: King's Arcade, 20-A, Markaz F-7, Islamabad, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://premiergrouppk.com/arpak/ and https://premiergrouppk.com/arpak/profileofthecompany.html (investment objective, company registration and NTN, Premier Group site) and https://premiergrouppk.com/arpak/contact.html (Islamabad address and telephones); the 1977 incorporation date is from the company's published company profile on the same group site (accessed 2026-10-17). No chief executive is named on the pages read, so ceo is null.
